newsitem.title: USA: ABC orders layoffs of 200 in budget cut - Times.
newsitem.headline: ABC orders layoffs of 200 in budget cut - Times.

text.p: ABC Television ordered layoffs of about 200 workers -- less than 4 percent of its 5,000-member workforce -- as it prepared to submit its annual budget to parent company Walt Disney, the New York Times reported, citing unnamed ABC executives.
Most of the layoffs occurred through voluntary acceptances of severance packages, although as many as 50 people were fired, the executives told the paper.
The cutbacks were made throughout ABC and affected virtually every department there, said a spokeswoman for the network.
ABC executives said the network took the step on its own without pressure from Disney. Executives also said the layoffs would be the last at the network for at least a year, the Times said.
